title: Med spa facial treatment ad
text: Macro skin textures and a calm message: take a break to take care of yourself
idea: A soft, sensory med spa ad. Extreme close-ups of skin and treatment tools carry a two-line message, so it works with the sound off.
why: Macro shots feel premium and clinical at once.
Short on-screen lines read in a single glance.
Built for Instagram Reels and Stories ads.
